cases.name: projected clipped-triangle reference agrees across rotated, occluded, narrow and translated Float32 frames
clip surfaces use visible exit faces and omit synthetic near caps, behind-camera and far-hidden boxes
equal-depth LEQUAL selects last source declaration without mutating matrices
outside rect and invalid matrix frames are null and never infer an author object
renderer hitTest uses the actual uploaded Float32 matrices and rect without extra draws or source changes
position-only canvas scrolling remaps current CSS client coordinates without redraw while size changes require a fresh frame
canvas position changes during a pending tap or before double-click revoke the old gesture owner
tap, native double-click and jitter emit stable UUID while author data remains intact
out-and-back drag remains a drag and prevents stale double-tap focus
cancel, capture loss, wheel, reset, refresh, resize and secondary pointer invalidate pending taps
last tap is cleared by misses, drag interruptions, wheel and model generation changes
callback throw and callback dispose leave capture released and no old handler resurrects a view
selection accepts only current stable UUID or null and repeats are exact no-draw view no-ops
selection redraw keeps actual Float32 geometry depth source order and one box pass with no resource allocation
selection does not reorder equal-depth ties or turn a hidden declared UUID into a geometric hit
onPick selection-only redraw and normal capture release preserve the native second tap and double click frame
selection-only redraw during a primary pending tap leaves geometry ownership valid and does not emit its own pick
selection redraw across changed allocation or CSS dimensions creates a fresh geometry owner and cancels old tap
position-only scrolling with selection redraw remains hittable but cannot authorize a tap spanning canvas movement
reset keeps selected UUID while source model replacement clears selection and old tap ownership
selection handles callback reentrancy without resurrecting a disposed model or author camera
lost context and dispose refuse selection or clear requests without draw mutation or callback
clipped rotated narrow far and millimetre scenes preserve all independent geometric picks after selected redraw

scope: Actual pure picking helper and actual renderer code with a WebGL uniform/event fixture. Independent homogeneous clipping and triangle-depth reference, actual Float32 uniform payloads, simulated pointer/capture/resize lifecycle. Includes independent selection-only redraw and resource/depth/order/gesture assertions. This fixture does not compile/rasterize the shader or prove edge pixels; real browser/GPU pixels are separate. No native/device/install or author/Save execution claim.
